messages:
clara (marketing): quick kickoff — need a compact benchmark narrative for the homepage + webinar landing. goal: two hero visuals (latency vs $/1k tokens + phase cost breakdown) and short copy for signup.
jon (growth): agree. CTA split: 'View results' vs 'Request dedicated bench' — the latter -> SDR queue. measure CTR -> signup.
mike (data): dropping provisional numbers (batch=8, seq median mix):
FastCfg: p50 88ms, p95 330ms, $0.58/1k
QuantCfg: p50 152ms, p95 490ms, $0.19/1k
Balanced: p50 112ms, p95 370ms, $0.37/1k
I'll publish CSV + harness link for reproducibility.
rachel (design): visual notes: scatter uses point size=throughput; hover shows p95 & config. waterfall splits prompt/gen/KV. mobile stacks charts and surfaces a single highlighted datapoint. hero badge: 'Measured on realistic production workloads'.
clara (marketing): messaging candidates: A) 'Production economics for builders' B) 'Ship faster. Spend smarter.' We'll A/B test both copy blocks on the landing.
lee (product): add one-liner about routing: 'Redwood routes by SLA and cost tier; falls back to compatible variants to avoid outages.' concise and concrete.
jon (growth): webinar: 20-min bench walkthrough + 15-min live Q&A. Wed 11am PT. Offer high-intent attendees a follow-up dedicated run.
mike (data): methodology snippet for page: dataset name, seq length distro, batching, quant settings — one short line each. helps with buyer trust.
rachel (design): microcopy under hero: 1) median & tail latency 2) unit cost per 1k tokens 3) routing & cache impact. will drop PNGs and hover spec by EOD tomorrow.
clara (marketing): inbound routing rules: chosen_CTA, org_size, wants_dedicated-> tag in CRM. SDR auto-notify on 'dedicated' picks.
lee (product): FAQ line: 'Are these numbers reproducible?' -> 'Yes — we publish the harness and can run guided reproductions for customers.' keep it short.
clara (marketing): next steps: mike finalize CSV, rachel deliver mockups, jon wire tracking & routing, lee finalize product bullets. reconvene Thu 9am PT. Thanks team :rocket:
